note: Counts for ArcaneTests.exe "~[gpu]", per configuration. `~[gpu]` is a BASELINE-COMPARABILITY convention, not a safety gate -- the [gpu] cases run clean on this hardware and CI runs the full unfiltered suite. A drop means coverage was lost; the check that reads this file is scripts/check-baselines.ps1. Dist legitimately runs fewer cases than Debug/Release (6 cases / 68 assertions fewer) because of pre-existing `#if !defined(ARCANE_DIST)` guards in HostConfigTest.cpp and NriDiagnosticsTest.cpp -- that gap has been constant across this whole arc.
